text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
She has finally done it, Mihono Bourbon! 
She has seized the crown of the Triple 
Crown Umamusume!
(UWAAAAAH--!)

A massive roar of cheers envelops Mihono 
Bourbon as she stands frozen.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Last year I cried from regret, but this 
year, I'm about to cry from joy...!

text_block_list.name: Short-Haired Reporter
text_block_list.text:
"...Bourbon...! You're incredible, you're 
an amazing horse girl!"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Me, a Triple Crown Umamusume...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I did it... Father... Master...!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: "Bour-bon! Bour-bon! Bour-bon! Bour-bon!"

"The spontaneous Bourbon chant didn't stop 
for quite some time."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Order completed...! Master...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
This is the result of Master's precise 
guidance— and your belief in me.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
To fulfill my "dream" and bring good news 
to my father makes me very "happy."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much, Master.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
—While the target has been achieved, there 
is still a second target remaining.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
In other words, a dream that serves as 
"proof of hard work,"— one that will 
"bring courage to the people."
choice_data_list: Let's make that come true together too!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Then, I request specific instructions.

She needs a stage where she can 
demonstrate her true abilities to the 
fullest. And so—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Spring). It's a 3,200m 
long-distance GⅠ race, isn't it?
choice_data_list:
I know you can run it all the way to the 
end!

I'm sure you can run it all the way to the 
end!

text_block_list.text:
"I'm sure that sight will give people 
courage." As I continued, Mihono Bourbon 
nodded.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I still cannot comprehend the causal 
relationship between 'courage' and racing. 
However, if it is Master's order, I shall 
execute it.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
We will make thorough adjustments heading 
into the Tenno Sho (Spring).

—Just as we arrived at the academy, Mihono 
Bourbon suddenly came to a halt.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ――! Unidentified error detected...

Mihono Bourbon pressed a hand against her 
chest looking bewildered, and closed her 
eyes.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And now, heading into the fourth corner of 
the Kikuka Sho, Rice Shower is making her 
move!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
(Her speed, her heat, her gaze, her 
breathing—! Rice-san's sheer spirit 
is...!)

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
(...Why am I, in the middle of a race, 
taking an interest in Rice-san—?)

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaahhhh!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
—Video footage of the Kikuka Sho 
automatically played. Rice's figure came 
vividly to mind.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Along with it, a 'commotion' is detected 
deep in my chest. What on earth... is 
this...?

Relieved to hear it isn't physical pain, 
but I still have no idea what it could be.

Remembering Rice Shower was likely what 
stirred up this unsettling feeling, but—

—Just then, high-pitched squeals erupted 
from passing high school girls.

text_block_list.name: High School Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, did you see that!? In this year's 
Kikuka Sho, Mihono Bourbon won the Triple 
Crown!

text_block_list.name: High School Girl B
text_block_list.text:
I saw it! It was incredible! A Triple 
Crown Umamusume, huh?

text_block_list.name: High School Girl B
text_block_list.text:
It was so unfortunate about Teio's injury 
last year. If those two raced each other, 
who'd be stronger?

Perhaps unaware of Mihono Bourbon, she was 
happily browsing online news.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Tokai, Teio...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...? Resumption of "buzzing" confirmed.
choice_data_list: Could it be... you're curious about Teio?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: No... I don't know...

With a bewildered expression, Mihono 
Bourbon placed a hand over her chest,
choice_data_list:
(To think she'd be paying attention to 
other Umamusume...)

text_block_list.text:
Though they had been constantly compared 
to each other, she had never once paid any 
mind to Tokai Teio.

It wasn't just Tokai Teio. Thinking of 
Rice Shower, my heart was filled with 
unease.

The true nature of the "unrest" born at 
the Kikuka Sho... It might be a much 
bigger change than I thought.

I hope this doesn't have a bad influence 
on our next target race, the Tenno Sho 
(Spring)...
